items.author: Claude (spectator finding, BL-1615)
items.title: Rivals with a staffed pad can buy a launch: spacecraft components and propellant reach the home shelf, and pads finish in reasonable time
items.design: The BL-1615 spectate (seed 0 to 1995) ends with 4 staffed rival pads and 0 launches. Three padded nations are refused rejected_shelf: their home market holds no spacecraft_components or propellant lot (components_lump 25, propellant_lump 50), though treasuries are 50 to 88k. The plants exist (recipes spacecraft_components, spacecraft_components_heavy, propellant_atmospheric) but nothing builds them: no demand shows before a launch. Second gap: pads take 5 to 9 years, some sites at rate 0 for want of materials. Fix as an in-world force, not a term in the agent: the space programme demand must be visible to the nation build scorer (2026-10-23 grant, own ground only) so it builds the plants, or the launch buy must post a standing order the market and builders can see. The retry loop (logistic_points.cpp ~2326) and the coverage read (lp_seed_read ~2555) disagree. Suspects: dcc117ee (own-market want, calibrated feed, logistics cap) and the kit logistics cap in opening_kit.cpp, which NR-1128 says keeps capital-stacked hubs out of the hub slots. Fix so seeding and coverage agree; a world-mover, so digests may move.

items.title: A world reaches play in under 60 s on the cold path
items.design: GENERATION_STRATEGY.md § The world budget (Ben, 2026-11-12). Measured 2026-11-12 on main: seed 28 about 37 s, seed 0 about 2.5-3 min (search 78 s, the Finishing step 25-50 s, the three spans about 22 s, settle 4 s). First split the Finishing step (label 12: market carve and gravity fold, market roads, other bodies, provinces, garrisons) into its own measured costs in gen_step_costs, then cut the largest until every curated seed opens in under 60 s. Read on the largest curated worlds. Depends on BL-1646 (search placement only) for the search share.

items.author: main session (Ben, 2026-11-12)
items.title: Majors carry their running bill from the first month
items.design: NATION_GENERATION.md § Pass 7: the kit's own income carries its running bill from the first tick. The opening-parity census (30:4, 16 seeds, five years) read majors losing money on average 10/64 before the monthly tick and 42/64 after it, with 3/64 ending under 100 credits and the median end treasury 6,441 -> 1,769. Ben ruled the regression folds into this item (2026-11-12). First find which per-tick flow the monthly tick (BL-1642) left at its quarterly rate, then re-read the census; any remaining loss is the kit's balance. Read by the opening-parity skill at --quarters 60. FOUND 2026-11-13: the national budget's per-tick spendable is a share of the treasury (a stock) and stayed the quarter's, so the research line's lump bill took it three times a quarter (research +37% a month). Fixed: k_budget_tick_share = 1/3 (NATIONS.md § 3). Census 30:4, 16 seeds, 60 months after the fix: losing 26/64, median end treasury 3,776, 1 under 100. Left: income 18% under the quarter's monthly rate - lumpier monthly trade, and alloys/machinery not made. That remainder is the kit's balance; opening_parity now prints FLOWS and GOOD lines to read it. READ 2026-11-13: the kit's running result is positive for 62/64 majors (its rule holds); the losers run down on research bought with credits (131 a month against a 114 running surplus). Ben ruled research free (BL-1650, free research rate), which is this item's lever: re-read the census once it lands. CLOSED (Ben, 2026-11-14): 0b8126ff (a tick spends a month's share) took losing majors 42 -> 26 of 64; 86ba9815 (BL-1650, free research) took them to 3 of 64, median end treasury 15,447, none under 100 (opening_parity 30:4, 16 seeds, 60 months).

items.author: main session (Ben, 2026-11-13)
items.title: Research is free: a 100 RP base, research buildings add 5% / 10%, no credit line, no economy source
items.design: RESEARCH.md § Research points (Ben, 2026-11-13). base_rp_per_nation 40 -> 100 a month; an institute adds 5% of the base, a University 10%, only while running (staffed, not idled, upkeep paid). Retire the credit line: the academic_research weight goes to zero and advance_research spends nothing (the enum slot and the return's research field stay for the save format). Drop rp_per_economy_unit. The nation research AI, the tech panel's RP estimate (estimate_rp_per_quarter_milli) and every player string that offers to spend on research follow. Measured before (opening_parity RESEARCH lines, 30:4, 16 seeds, 60 months): median major 163 RP a month = base 40 + line 72 (about 180 credits) + two institutes 33 + economy 16; at the ruling a major with two institutes earns 110. Re-measure: the opening-parity census (BL-1647, majors losing money) and the RESEARCH.md § Cost pacing sweep (first ring-2 major, median and fastest tenth), and report both to Ben; the pacing re-pin is his. CLOSED (Ben, 2026-11-14): 86ba9815. Digests 16/16 unmoved; every major 112 RP a month; first ring-2 major median 112 months, p10 102, all reach it - re-pinned by Ben (6f433135).

items.author: main session (Ben, 2026-11-14)
items.title: A rich rival nation spends its surplus on buildings, economy or military
items.design: NATIONS.md § 3 (the national budget). READ 2026-11-14 after BL-1650 (free research rate), opening_parity 30:4, 16 seeds, 60 months: median major end treasury 15,447 (was 3,776 with the credit line), 61 of 64 winners averaging +230 a month total. The academic weight still takes its slot in the split but spends nothing, so its share stays in the treasury. WORK: measure where the unspent surplus sits (academic slot vs other lines under-spending vs reserve), then decide whether a rich nation should build more (research buildings, processors), whether the split should redistribute an unspent line, or whether this level is fine. Ben's call which; a brake must be an in-world force, not an agent handicap. Do not clamp the treasury. RULED (Ben, 2026-11-14): "rich nations build more, be it economy or military" - NATIONS.md § 3, "A rich nation builds more; wealth is spent, not held". Rival nations only; the player's nation is untouched. WORK: (1) measure why a rival holding 15k does not build now (the scorer's solvency gate, reserve, candidate supply or emphasis); (2) let the surplus raise its build and hire appetite through the existing scored-utility verbs; (3) re-read opening_parity: end treasury and buildings per major. OPEN GRANT: force sizing (AI_OPPONENT.md § 11, 2026-11-08) targets a share of INCOME; letting the military target also read the treasury surplus is a widening to raise with Ben, not assume.
